brief.zh: 「有一个人，给且只给不给自己刮胡子的人刮胡子。」写一段脚本，证明没有这样的人。
brief.en: “There is someone who shaves exactly those who do not shave themselves.” Write a script that proves there is no such person.

hint.zh: 假设有这么一个人，把他拿出来，叫他 b。
hint.en: Suppose there is such a person; take him out and call him b.

t.zh: 最后一段脚本，用上这台证明器的每一层。
t.en: A last script, using every layer of this prover.

after.zh: 证明器从两个元件长到这里，没有一步是核不认的。
after.en: The prover grew from two parts to this, and not one step was one the kernel would not take.
